authority_boundary: External projects can supply adapters and patterns. One Chop Core remains the sole authority for membership, organizer powers, canonical money events, confirmation, closeout, and recovery.

evidence_grades.verified_source: A commit-pinned repository record was inspected. This verifies only the cited pattern, not ChopDot implementation or fitness.
evidence_grades.registry_discovery: A content-addressed Devnet directory row was verified. Source, runtime behavior, security, and license remain unverified.
evidence_grades.indirect_pattern: Verified source demonstrates a useful infrastructure or lifecycle pattern, but not the ChopDot feature itself.
evidence_grades.chopdot_original: The behavior is a ChopDot product requirement or hypothesis; no direct external implementation was verified.
evidence_grades.no_analog_found: No direct analog was found in the frozen repository and Devnet universes.

feature_families.name: Entry, account, people, membership, and recovery
feature_families.product_outcome: The same person can enter, join the correct group with explicit authority, manage payment instruments, and recover on a fresh device without identity drift.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Host/account identity adapters, per-account caches, scoped storage, signed delivery envelopes, and identity-directory discovery patterns.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No inspected donor establishes ChopDot membership, organizer authority, actor-bound recovery, or same-person convergence.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Signed membership events, explicit role grants, actor-bound payment-instrument ownership, idempotent projection rebuild, revocation, and fresh-device recovery.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Two-person fresh-device recovery with invite replay, wrong-actor rejection, payment-instrument isolation, revocation, and identical final projections.

feature_families.name: Group cards, home, and normal-language shell
feature_families.product_outcome: Each group appears as a living money commitment with one obvious next actor and action, never as a ledger or protocol console.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Small shared-state summaries and role-aware status projections can inform the data behind a card.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No inspected project implements the living ChopDot group-card model or proves first-screen comprehension.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Derive card state and next action from canonical group events without adding a second authority model.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Five first-time-user comprehension tests across requested, marked-paid, received, ready-to-close, closed, saved, offline, empty, loading, and unavailable states.

feature_families.name: Normal pots, dinners, trips, and couple expenses
feature_families.product_outcome: A group can capture shared spending, keep changing the record, settle what is open, and preserve a readable history.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Role separation, lifecycle decomposition, dispute evidence, persistent coordination, and contract-to-content reference patterns.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: The donors are marketplaces, merchant payments, surveys, or event apps; none proves ChopDot's editable group-expense journey.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: One group/event model from first expense through corrections, settlement, confirmation, and immutable closeout.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Three-person dinner on two devices covering forgotten expense, member change, partial payment, delay, dispute, confirmation, close, and return to history.

feature_families.name: Paid-moment, receipt, link, chat, and spend capture
feature_families.product_outcome: Capture starts from a photo, link, import, text, or observed spend; manual item entry is only correction.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Encrypted/content-addressed blob transport, scoped local drafts, and host storage adapters.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No inspected source proves ChopDot OCR, spend-to-receipt matching, correction UX, dedupe, itemized split, or privacy redaction.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: A capture draft cannot alter canonical money state until a person reviews and commits normalized exact-money events.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Photo/link/chat/spend capture on web and host with OCR failure, correction, duplicate, conflict, sensitive-item redaction, offline sync, and refund.

feature_families.name: Exact money, splits, currencies, and corrections
feature_families.product_outcome: Every amount, currency, split, correction, refund, and payment leg stays exact and auditable.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Typed balances, asynchronous payment state, contract dependency boundaries, dispute-state decomposition, and lifecycle tests.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No donor supplies ChopDot's exact-money event contract, mixed-currency correction semantics, or split reconciliation.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Integer minor units, explicit currency, immutable event IDs, reversals instead of mutation, and deterministic projection rules.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Property and scenario tests for rounding, multi-currency legs, partials, over/underpayment, duplicate events, refund, reversal, and replay order.

feature_families.name: Invitations, links, QR, and no-app payment requests
feature_families.product_outcome: A friend sees only who requests what, for which group, and the one safe action available without unnecessary setup.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Payment-request identifiers, QR/link handoff, asynchronous status subscription, host signing, and replay-safe delivery.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: A link or verified contact does not prove membership, organizer authority, recipient consent, or payment acceptance.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Purpose-bound expiring capability links with explicit group/action scope, replay protection, and separate membership acceptance.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Fresh-browser invite/payment-link matrix for valid, expired, replayed, forwarded, wrong-actor, revoked, and already-completed links.

feature_families.name: Wallets, PAS, DOT, USDC, CASH, and external payment rails
feature_families.product_outcome: ChopDot proposes the minimum transfer plan, lets users choose a rail, observes exact evidence when possible, and never becomes custodian.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Host-mediated signer/permission APIs, typed payment lifecycle, chain observation, request/subscribe patterns, and payment-schedule discovery.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: Registry payment claims and merchant server flows do not prove ChopDot settlement, availability, finality, or user consent.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Payment instrument ownership, proposed-versus-observed-versus-confirmed states, rail-neutral legs, and no custody.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Two-party PAS/DOT/USDC/external flow covering rejection, cancellation, fee, wrong currency, partial, delayed observation, and receiver confirmation.

feature_families.name: Receiver confirmation, delay, waiver, dispute, and closeout
feature_families.product_outcome: The group distinguishes claimed, observed, received, disputed, waived, delayed, and closed states before saving the record.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Explicit disputes, asynchronous statuses, evidence references, and role-gated transitions.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No donor implements ChopDot's receiver-confirmed truth or its closeout rule across external and on-chain rails.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Only authorized actors can transition named states; close is allowed only after every item is resolved and remains append-only.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Full resolution table across paid claim, chain observation, received, not received, partial, delayed, waived, disputed, reopened, and closed.

feature_families.name: Saved history, privacy, redaction, export, and deletion
feature_families.product_outcome: Closed records remain readable and recoverable while private details, retention, export, and deletion are explicit.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Content-addressed encrypted bytes, short-message carriers, and discovery-level collaborative save-point concepts.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: OpenDocs, PolkaNote, and dot-drive are registry-only; Bulletin retention does not itself provide durable ChopDot history or deletion guarantees.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Canonical signed event history, encrypted projections/blobs, selective redaction, export manifest, retention policy, and recoverable keys.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Export/import and fresh-device recovery with missing blob, expired retention, key loss, redacted view, deletion request, and immutable financial event preservation.

feature_families.name: Live sync, offline work, chat capture, and notifications
feature_families.product_outcome: Participants can act across devices and surfaces, recover from offline work, and receive useful prompts without duplicate or unauthorized state.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Publish/subscribe, topic filtering, local drafts, host isolation, and bounded signed-envelope transport.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: Statement Store is non-durable delivery and no inspected app proves ChopDot Telegram/chat capture or conflict convergence.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Idempotent signed envelopes, causal ordering, actor checks, acknowledgement separate from acceptance, replay, conflict policy, and projection rebuild.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Two-device offline/online conflict run with reordered, duplicated, expired, rejected, and replayed messages plus chat-derived draft confirmation.

feature_families.name: Savings circles
feature_families.product_outcome: Members contribute in recurring rounds, see who is due, confirm payout, and preserve a fair record without ChopDot holding funds.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: CircleCredit proves only that a lending-circle app is listed; payment lifecycle and role/state patterns can be studied indirectly.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: CircleCredit source, license, security, rules, recovery, and runtime behavior were not inspected; lending credit is not automatically a rotating savings circle.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Round schedule, membership/roles, expected contributions, delays, payout order, receiver confirmation, exceptions, and immutable round closeout without custody or automatic payout.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Obtain and audit CircleCredit source or runtime protocol, then run a five-member round with late/missed contribution, changed order, disputed payout, member exit, recovery, and closeout.

feature_families.name: Emergency and private-help pots
feature_families.product_outcome: A group can coordinate urgent help with dignity, minimal disclosure, explicit approvals, and a redacted closeout.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Encrypted blob storage, role-gated shared state, and explicit dispute/evidence states are indirect ingredients.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No direct emergency-help analog, dignity model, selective disclosure flow, or safe redacted closeout was verified.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Private pledges, approver scope, recipient consent, minimum disclosure, release record, safe notifications, and redacted history without custody.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Threat-model and five-role scenario for private pledge, approval refusal, partial release, compromised link, sensitive note, recipient revocation, and redacted export.

feature_families.name: Community funds
feature_families.product_outcome: A community records contributions, requests, approvals, payment, receiver confirmation, and transparent handoff without turning ChopDot into a DAO or custodian.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: PublicResearch is a directory-level funding lead; verified donors show roles, approvals, evidence CIDs, disputes, and small contract indexes.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No inspected donor proves ChopDot's community-fund governance, non-custodial handoff, privacy, recovery, or closeout.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Explicit admin/approver/contributor/payer/receiver/viewer roles, approval thresholds, payment evidence, receiver confirmation, export, and authority handoff.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Audit PublicResearch source/protocol and run a six-role fund from contribution through rejected/approved request, payment, confirmation, admin handoff, export, and recovery.

feature_families.name: Polkadot host, DotNS delivery, and invisible native adapters
feature_families.product_outcome: The same ChopDot product runs in web and host surfaces with content-addressed delivery, explicit permissions, signing, storage, and rollback while native terms remain invisible.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Content-addressed host loading, DotNS resolution, permission-mediated APIs, signer/storage adapters, and host simulation.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: Infrastructure source does not prove ChopDot product completeness, live account identity, bundle compatibility, deployment ownership, rollback, or first-time usability.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Provider-neutral adapters around canonical domain services; identical authority and event semantics across web, simulator, dot.li, and Desktop.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Aligned SDK/TrUAPI/host build through simulator, content-addressed publish candidate, DotNS resolve, real-host two-person walkthrough, offline return, and rollback rehearsal.

feature_families.name: Product assurance, cockpit, agents, pilots, and adversarial review
feature_families.product_outcome: Claims about the product stay tied to scenario, screenshot, source, test, deployment, and user-reachability evidence.
feature_families.what_is_reusable: Host simulation and adapter tests can shorten the native feedback loop.
feature_families.what_is_not_proven: No external app can prove ChopDot's cockpit freshness, product judgment, multi-person recovery, accessibility, or public usability.
feature_families.one_chop_core_requirement: Trace requirements to deterministic scenarios and distinguish implemented, tested, committed, deployed, reachable, and human-walked states.
feature_families.missing_experiment: Refresh the cockpit in a clean candidate, eliminate stale source warnings, cover all mapped paths, then run a real multi-person adversarial walkthrough on the deploy candidate.
